hypothesis.statement: The unchanged SP500 fresh15 v3 route can produce attributable, source-native long and short lifecycle evidence under its frozen exit and cost contract.
hypothesis.why_updated: The first eligible onset after the frozen-source epoch was observed and its exact partial lifecycle can now be reconciled.

prior_exact_v51_completed_short.largest_winner_dependency: complete because the sample contains one winner
prior_exact_v51_completed_short.interpretation: A single prior short is technical lifecycle evidence, not deployable expectancy.

current_frozen_epoch.interpretation: The new short is adverse but still open under the configured contract; it is not a loss or completed trade.

evidence_context.active_v57_effect: none; SP500 is not an executable V57 asset
evidence_context.v58_effect: observer-only; no orders, fills, signing client, or capital exposure

mark_capture_reconciliation.interpretation: The stopped REST recorder is a visible research-health issue, but exact WebSocket marks independently resolved this event through the cutoff. REST marks were not used to certify the path.

hypothesis_decision.recommendation: Keep V57 and V58 route parameters unchanged. Continue the isolated observer and rerun the immutable lifecycle only after a configured exit, the 24-hour fallback, an opposite eligible onset, or a material evidence failure.
hypothesis_decision.why_now: The event supplies the first post-epoch eligible SP500 onset, but its configured lifecycle is unfinished.
hypothesis_decision.evidence_reviewed: Prospective decision journal, exact depth-10 book prefix, exact WebSocket mark archive, frozen 15-minute signal candles, frozen completed one-minute profit-lock candles, official funding snapshot, V58 execution config, exact fee evidence, and prior v51 lifecycle disposition.
hypothesis_decision.observed_problem_or_opportunity: The SP500 source path is functioning and attributable; economic evidence remains one prior completed short plus one unfinished short and no long lifecycle.
hypothesis_decision.applicable_market_regime: Only the exact fresh15 v3 onset observed at 2026-08-19T06:15:00Z; no session or regime generalization is supported.
hypothesis_decision.alternatives_considered: Promote after the first onset, impose an ad hoc early exit, relax entry gates, treat fixed-horizon markouts as PnL, or continue the frozen contract. Only continued frozen observation preserves the hypothesis.
hypothesis_decision.expected_upside: A fully resolved source-native lifecycle updates stop, profit-lock, opposite-exit, cost, and side-breadth evidence without contaminating the route contract.
hypothesis_decision.main_risks_and_failure_modes: The lifecycle may remain open, later source gaps may censor it, one outcome may dominate the sample, and archive/live source parity blockers remain unresolved.
hypothesis_decision.validation_completed: Entry identity, exact depth, exact mark continuity to cutoff, stop non-cross, completed-bar profit-lock non-activation, opposite-onset absence, and immutable source/config identities.
hypothesis_decision.validation_still_required: The configured exit, exact exit depth, funding through exit, both-side lifecycle evidence, and largest-winner-robust after-cost results.
hypothesis_decision.success_metrics: At least one technically resolved lifecycle per configured side for diagnosis; any future change recommendation still requires the predeclared compatible window and robustness criteria in the baseline journal.
hypothesis_decision.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Any consumed prefix changes, exact mark gap exceeds five seconds, exit depth is unavailable, source/config identity changes, or completed after-cost evidence is negative or winner-dependent.
hypothesis_decision.confidence_level: High on event identity and technical evidence through the cutoff; low on profitability because the lifecycle is unfinished and side breadth is absent.

limitations: This is an unfinished observer lifecycle and contains no realized or simulated completed PnL.
The entry and any future exit are causal depth-replay approximations, not historical venue fills.
A complete path through the current cutoff does not prove future capture continuity.
One prior completed short and one unfinished short cannot establish profitability, frequency, or both-side robustness.
No strategy, asset, route, parameter, stop, exit, leverage, sizing, live configuration, or process was changed.
falsifier: Update this disposition when the frozen lifecycle reaches a configured exit or becomes technically unresolved. Reject any economic inference if exact path, exit-depth, funding, source identity, side breadth, after-cost, or largest-winner criteria fail.
